---
title: "API"
---

Fair Data Finder exposes a single HTTP API under the `/api` prefix. The same
surface powers the Nuxt frontend and external clients. Interactive
documentation is available when the backend is running:

- Swagger UI: `{API}/api.html`
- OpenAPI JSON: `{API}/api`

## What the API is used for

| Area | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| **STAC** | Domains (Collections), datasets (Items), search, queryables |
| **Keywords** | Facilities, keyword groups, keywords |
| **RBAC** | Users list, groups, members, roles, permissions |
| **Auth** | Microsoft SSO login, logout, session (`/auth/*`) |

STAC details, examples, and CQL2 search are documented under [STAC](stac.qmd).

## How the frontend talks to the backend

```{mermaid}
flowchart LR
  Browser --> Proxy[Caddy / nginx<br/>same origin]
  Proxy -->|/api/*| Backend[FastAPI<br/>stac-fastapi]
  Proxy -->|everything else| Frontend[Nuxt]
  Frontend -->|SSR internal| Backend
```

- Browser requests use the relative base URL `/api` so frontend and backend
  share one origin (required for the `DMS_TOKEN` cookie).
- The typed client is generated from the OpenAPI schema
  (`nuxt-open-fetch`).
- Server-side rendering calls the backend on the internal Docker network
  (for example `http://backend:8000/api`) and forwards cookies.

## STAC API vs application API

There is **one** FastAPI application — not two services. The distinction is
conceptual:

| | STAC routes | Application routes |
|--|-------------|-------------------|
| **Data store** | `pgstac` schema | `public` schema |
| **Examples** | `/collections`, `/search`, `/collections/{id}/items` | `/facility`, `/keywords`, `/groups`, `/auth/login` |
| **Payloads** | STAC Catalog / Collection / Item JSON | SQLModel request/response models |

Extensions registered on the same app add keywords, RBAC, and SSO alongside
core STAC operations.

## Authentication

Session auth uses the **`DMS_TOKEN` cookie** (JWT after SSO). See
[STAC → Authentication](stac.qmd#authentication).

```bash
curl -H "Cookie: DMS_TOKEN=$DMS_TOKEN" \
  "{API}/groups"
```

Many write operations also require **permissions** derived from the user's
group roles (for example `item:create` on a collection, or `keyword:all`).

## Application endpoints (summary)

Paths below are relative to `{API}` (your Fair Data Finder base URL).
All listed routes require a valid `DMS_TOKEN` unless noted.

### Auth

| Method | Path | Auth | Description |
|--------|------|------|-------------|
| `GET` | `/auth/login` | Public | Start Microsoft SSO |
| `GET` | `/auth/callback` | Public | OAuth callback; sets `DMS_TOKEN` |
| `GET` | `/auth/logout` | Public | Clear session cookie |
| `GET` | `/auth/me` | Requires `DMS_TOKEN` | Current user profile |

### Keywords / facilities

| Method | Path | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| `GET` / `POST` | `/facility`, `/facilities` | Create facility; list facilities |
| `GET` / `PUT` / `DELETE` | `/facility/{facility_id}` | Read / update / delete facility |
| `POST` / `DELETE` | `/facility_keywordgroup_link` | Link facility ↔ keyword group |
| `GET` / `POST` | `/keywordgroup`, `/keywordgroups` | Create / list keyword groups |
| `GET` / `PUT` / `DELETE` | `/keywordgroup/{keywordgroup_id}` | Manage one group |
| `GET` / `POST` | `/keyword`, `/keywords` | Create / list keywords (`?facility_id=` or `?keyword_group_id=`) |
| `GET` / `PUT` / `DELETE` | `/keyword/{keyword_id}` | Manage one keyword |

Mutating keyword routes require the `keyword:all` permission.

### Groups, users, and roles

| Method | Path | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| `GET` | `/users` | Users known to the app (SSO logins) |
| `GET` / `POST` | `/groups` | List / create groups |
| `GET` / `PUT` / `DELETE` | `/groups/{group_id}` | Manage a group |
| `GET` / `POST` / `DELETE` | `/groups/{group_id}/members` | Group membership |
| `GET` | `/roles` | Available roles |
| `POST` / `DELETE` | `/group-role` | Assign / remove **global** roles |
| `POST` / `GET` / `DELETE` | `/group-role/{collection_id}` | Collection-scoped roles |
| `GET` | `/permissions` | Permissions for the current user |
| `GET` | `/collection-permissions` | Collection permissions overview |
| `GET` | `/collection-permissions/{collection_id}` | Permissions for one collection |

### STAC (pointer)

| Method | Path | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| `GET` | `/` | Catalog |
| `GET` / `POST` | `/collections` | List / create domains |
| `GET` / `PUT` / `PATCH` / `DELETE` | `/collections/{collection_id}` | One domain |
| `GET` / `POST` | `/collections/{collection_id}/items` | List / create datasets |
| `GET` / `PUT` / `PATCH` / `DELETE` | `/collections/{collection_id}/items/{item_id}` | One dataset |
| `GET` / `POST` | `/search` | Item search |
| `GET` | `/queryables` | Filterable properties |

Full STAC documentation: [STAC](stac.qmd).
